issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change, violating TDD and the Livewire definition of done which requires happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call and tamper tests.
Client-writable mode is passed unchecked to CallMode::from, so a tampered value throws ValueError and returns 500 instead of validation handling.
Public actions rely only on domain-action authorization and never call $this->authorize on the resolved model, violating Livewire rule 3.
Helper is public and therefore a Livewire endpoint, violating the contract which lists only callNext() and the keep-helpers-protected rule.
Tab state is directly client-writable and bypasses setActiveTab validation, though impact is limited to rendering neither tab.
Last-called ticket is looked up globally by key instead of scoped to the entity; low risk because the id is #[Locked] and server-set.
Mode selector label reuses members_role and options render raw enum values instead of translated labels.
Queues empty state reuses serve_empty instead of a queue-specific string.
closeQueue calls reset() and then redundantly assigns the same null/false values explicitly.
Queues render always loads memberships with users even when the access modal is closed.

conventions.evidence: Uses CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket, {{ }} escaping, sibling Layout/Locked style and CHANGELOG; but no #[Validate] on name/renameName/mode, 4 mutating Queues actions lack $this->authorize, callableQueues is public

readability.evidence: Clear names, small focused methods, consistent Bulma/modal structure; detractors: members_role label for mode, serve_empty reused for queues empty, redundant resets in closeQueue/create

requirements.evidence: Queues list/detail/rename-with-reslug/toggle-modal/access-grants, Serve callable filter/call-order-30/empty-inactive notices/rate-limit-10-per-min, tabs and navbar present (Queues.php:192-198,228-234,253-267; Serve.php:336,365-391,405-417); gaps: invalid mode crashes via CallMode::from, extra public callableQueues vs contract

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the task: Queues/Serve components+views, routes entity.queues/entity.serve, tabs, navbar, lang keys, CHANGELOG; extra lang keys are supporting UI strings, no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: Scoped findOrFail for queues/memberships, #[Locked] entity and lastCalledTicketId, no {!! !!}; gaps: unvalidated mode -> CallMode::from ValueError, rename/toggle/grant/revoke without $this->authorize but guarded in actions, writable activeTab

simplicity.evidence: Reuses domain actions, Gate::allows call filter, RateLimiter, existing layout/Blade patterns; minor waste: double reset of name/viewing state, unconditional memberships query

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ files: no Pest coverage for queues create/rename/toggle/access, serve callNext/mode/rate-limit, nor unauthorized-call or tamper tests

review.summary: Adds tenant queues management and serve panel with tabs and navbar entries, closely following the task contract and scoped-lookup security pattern. Blocked by missing test suite and unvalidated serve mode that crashes on tampered input, plus missing explicit authorization in mutating Queue actions.
